title: instrument-token-phase-breakdown-and-slo-attenuation
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Add per-token-phase latency/cost quantiles, KV-hit annotated traces, and SLO attenuation to reduce alert noise from cold-start phases.
description:
Summary: Add a new observability surface that breaks down inference invocations into token phases (client prefix, prompt, generation, post-process) and emits per-phase token-level quantiles and cost attribution. Introduces an SLO attenuation mechanism for alerts that downweights known noisy phases (startup/cold-cache) and reduces duplicate alert churn for long-tail tenants. Motivation: long-tail SLO noise is dominated by a small number of high-cost but low-frequency cold-start invocations and post-processing spikes. By segmenting token latency/cost into phases and attenuating alerts from noisy phases, we can improve signal-to-noise for on-call and reduce pager fatigue. Checklist: - [x] Define token phases and add instrumentation hooks in serving runtime - [x] Emit Prometheus/OTel metrics for per-phase token quantiles and aggregated cost - [x] Annotate traces with phase boundaries and KV cache hit/miss tags - [x] Dashboard panels (per-tenant & per-model filters) and a lightweight example dashboard in dashboards/ - [x] Add unit tests for instrumentation and a small integration test that simulates prefix warm/cold requests - [x] Add e2e smoke test in perf-canary to validate attenuation reduces alert rate under synthetic coldstart workload Changes (high-level): - runtime/telemetry/token_phase_instrumentation.go: new phase boundaries + helpers to emit per-phase histograms and labels - runtime/telemetry/phase_labels.py: helper enum used by tracing and metrics collectors - runtime/collector/prom_exporter.go: add per-phase prometheus histograms and labels, plus cost-attribution gauge - runtime/tracing/phase_annotations.cpp: attach phase start/end events to spans and include kv_hit boolean - dashboards/token-phase-explorer.json: new Grafana panels showing stacked per-phase token latency distribution, per-phase p50/p95/p99, and token-cost waterfall per invocation - alerting/slo/attenuation_rule.yaml: new attenuation rule with tunable windows per phase - tests/integration/test_token_phase_attenuation.py: synthetic workload exercising warm vs cold prefix and asserting alert rate reduction - docs/observability/token-phases.md: design doc and examples Commits: - 0f3b9c2 Add token phase enums and basic phase markers - 9a7d1f4 Emit per-phase histograms to Prometheus - 2b6e8a1 Trace annotation for KV cache hit/miss - d1f4a22 Add dashboard panels and dashboard JSON - e8a3f67 Add attenuation rule and tests - f1c2e30 Fix flaky integration test on CI Changed files (selected snippets): - runtime/telemetry/token_phase_instrumentation.go (new): emits histograms named redwood_token_latency_phase_seconds{phase="generation|prompt|prefix|post"} and labels tenant/model/region - runtime/tracing/phase_annotations.cpp (new): span->SetAttribute("phase", phase_name); span->SetAttribute("kv_hit", kv_hit); - dashboards/token-phase-explorer.json (new): includes heatmap of token latency over time split by phase and interactive tenant dropdown - alerting/slo/attenuation_rule.yaml (new): rule: |
  name: "slo:token-latency-attenuation"
  description: "Ignore or downweight alerts originating primarily from prefix or post phases within a short window"
  phases: [prefix, post]
  attenuation_window: 10m
  attenuation_factor: 0.2 Review conversation (excerpt): - Mateo Ruiz (reviewer): "Nice decomposition. Two asks: 1) please add an explicit metric documenting the percent of total token cost attributed to each phase so ops can create budget views; 2) clarify attenuation behavior when multiple phases are noisy." - Aisha (author): "Added redwood_token_cost_phase_fraction gauge and expanded attenuation_rule.yaml explanation to prefer attributing to the heaviest-cost phase and only attenuate if phase_fraction > 0.6. See last commit e8a3f67." - Linnea Sørensen (reviewer): "Can we avoid exposing too many high-cardinality labels by limiting model label to model_family for the histogram? Also ensure tenant is optional in the exported metric so internal infra doesn't explode." - Aisha: "Made model label model_family and tenant label optional; exporter falls back to 'unknown' when missing. Updated tests to assert label cardinality bounds." - Priya Patel (reviewer): "Docs are good. One minor nit: add an example for how a user would 'opt-out' of attenuation for a tenant that needs strict alerts." - Aisha: "Added a tenant-level annotation in attenuation_rule.yaml and described it in docs/observability/token-phases.md." CI: - Unit tests: pass - Integration: flaky on first run (timing in canary), retried and passed - Lint: pass - Security scan: informational findings only (no blocking issues) Performance notes: - End-to-end synthetic coldstart workload in perf-canary shows 42% reduction in alert firing after attenuation with no measurable impact to SLO coverage for persistent high-latency generation phases. - Per-phase histograms add ~0.6% CPU overhead and 3% additional memory in the exporter process; considered acceptable for the observability benefit Rollout plan: - Canary on staging and perf-canary for 48h - Enable dashboards for SRE and Platform on day 1 - Enable attenuation in opt-in mode (logs-only) for 72h, then auto-apply attenuation in tenant groups with >1 month of usage history - Collect feedback and tune attenuation_factor per tenant and per model_family Post-merge follow-ups (TODOs): - Add example alerts that use the new phase_fraction metric for budget dashboards - Add an SDK helper to simplify reading phase-annotated traces in the Python/TS SDKs - Consider exporting compacted per-tenant daily rollups to reduce long-term storage cost Related work: ENG-4521 (observability initiative), ENG-4607 (slo noise reduction). Links: - docs/observability/token-phases.md - dashboards/token-phase-explorer.json - alerting/slo/attenuation_rule.yaml Merge outcome: Squash-merged after approvals from Mateo and Linnea and green CI.
